ir.name: pairwise_advantage_clamped
ir.intuition: Constructs pairwise preference pairs based on objective values, applying explicit clamping to advantage_gap weights to ensure numerical stability and avoid extreme values, while preserving pairwise comparison semantics. This approach helps maintain stable training and avoids gate failures caused by unbounded weights.
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache["objective"]  # (B,K)
    log_prob = feature_cache["log_prob"]  # (B,K)
    B, K = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    idxs = torch.arange(K, device=device)
    winner_idx = idxs.repeat_interleave(K)  # (K*K,)
    loser_idx = idxs.repeat(K)              # (K*K,)
    mask = winner_idx != loser_idx          # exclude self-pairs
    winner_idx = winner_idx[mask]            # (num_pairs,)
    loser_idx = loser_idx[mask]              # (num_pairs,)

    num_pairs = winner_idx.size(0)
    b_idx = torch.arange(B, device=device).repeat_interleave(num_pairs)  # (B*num_pairs,)

    winner_idx = winner_idx.repeat(B)  # (B*num_pairs,)
    loser_idx = loser_idx.repeat(B)    # (B*num_pairs,)

    obj_w = objective[b_idx, winner_idx]
    obj_l = objective[b_idx, loser_idx]

    winner_mask = obj_w <= obj_l
    true_winner_idx = torch.where(winner_mask, winner_idx, loser_idx)
    true_loser_idx = torch.where(winner_mask, loser_idx, winner_idx)

    advantage_gap = (objective[b_idx, true_loser_idx] - objective[b_idx, true_winner_idx])
    advantage_gap = advantage_gap.clamp(max=1.0)

    pair_idx = (b_idx, true_winner_idx, true_loser_idx)

    return PrefBatch(mode="pairwise", pair_idx=pair_idx, weight=advantage_gap, meta={})
